description: This file defines the MenuLinkContentForm class, a Drupal form class for adding and updating content menu links within the Drupal CMS. It includes methods for constructing the form, handling form submissions, and managing menu link entities.

classes.name: MenuLinkContentForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for creating and editing content menu links, extending ContentEntityForm.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as entity repository, menu parent selector, path validator, entity type bundle info, and time service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the form class using the service container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form array, including the menu parent selection element.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, setting submit button as primary and access for delete.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Populates the menu link entity with form values before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the menu link entity and redirects to its canonical URL.
